parameters.name: ExpectedValue
parameters.description: When you add the Value parameter, use ExpectedValue with PropertyType and ExpressionOperator. When you use these parameters, the folder must satisfy the rule to indicate the presence of this application. This ExpectedValue parameter specifies the value to compare against the file system. parameters.name: PolicyState
parameters.description: Use this parameter to configure the policy. - Enabled: If you enable this policy setting, Windows mounts all fixed data drives that BitLocker doesn't protect as read-only. If BitLocker protects the drive, Windows mounts it  with read and write access. - Disabled or NotConfigured: If you disable or don't configure this policy setting, Windows mounts all fixed data drives on the computer with read and write access.

parameters.name: MinimumLength
parameters.description: Passwords must be at least 8 characters. To configure a greater minimum length for the password, use this parameter.

parameters.name: PasswordComplexity
parameters.description: Use this parameter to configure password complexity for fixed data drives. To enforce complexity requirements on the password, set the value to Require. - Require: When you enable BitLocker, a connection to a domain controller is necessary to validate the complexity of the password. - Allow: The device tries to connect to a domain controller to validate the complexity. If it can't communicate with a domain controller, it still accepts the password whatever the actual complexity. BitLocker encrypts the drive using that password as a protector. - Prohibit: The client doesn't connect to a domain controller to validate the password complexity.

parameters.name: PolicyState
parameters.description: Use this parameter to configure the policy. - Enabled: If you enable this policy, users can configure a password that meets the requirements you define. To enforce complexity requirements on the password, use -PasswordComplexity Require. - Disabled: If you disable this policy, the user can't use a password. - NotConfigured: If you don't configure this policy, BitLocker supports passwords for fixed data drives with the default settings. The default settings don't include password complexity requirements and require only eight characters.

parameters.description: Add this parameter to require a password to unlock a BitLocker-protected fixed data drive.

New-CMGlobalCondition.syntax:
New-CMGlobalCondition -DataType <GlobalConditionDataType> [-Description <String>]
 -DeviceType <GlobalConditionDeviceType> -DistinguishedName <String> -LdapFilter <String>
 [-LdapPrefix <String>] -Name <String> -Property <String> -SearchScope <SearchScope> [-DisableWildcardHandling]
 [-ForceWildcardHandling] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]

New-CMGlobalCondition [-AllInstances] -Column <String> -Database <String> -DataType <GlobalConditionDataType>
 [-Description <String>] -DeviceType <GlobalConditionDeviceType> -FilePath <String> -Name <String>
 [-DisableWildcardHandling] [-ForceWildcardHandling] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]

New-CMGlobalCondition -AssemblyName <String> [-Description <String>] -DeviceType <GlobalConditionDeviceType>
 -Name <String> [-DisableWildcardHandling] [-ForceWildcardHandling] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]

New-CMGlobalCondition -Class <String> -DataType <GlobalConditionDataType> [-Description <String>]
 -DeviceType <GlobalConditionDeviceType> -Name <String> [-Namespace <String>] -Property <String>
 [-WhereClause <String>] [-DisableWildcardHandling] [-ForceWildcardHandling] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm]
 [<CommonParameters>]

New-CMGlobalCondition -Column <String> -Database <String> -DataType <GlobalConditionDataType>
 [-DefaultInstance] [-Description <String>] -DeviceType <GlobalConditionDeviceType> -FilePath <String>
 -Name <String> [-DisableWildcardHandling] [-ForceWildcardHandling] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]

New-CMGlobalCondition -Column <String> -Database <String> -DataType <GlobalConditionDataType>
 [-Description <String>] -DeviceType <GlobalConditionDeviceType> -FilePath <String> -InstanceName <String>
 -Name <String> [-DisableWildcardHandling] [-ForceWildcardHandling] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]

New-CMGlobalCondition -DataType <GlobalConditionDataType> [-Description <String>]
 -DeviceType <GlobalConditionDeviceType> [-MetabasePath <String>] -Name <String> -PropertyId <String>
 [-DisableWildcardHandling] [-ForceWildcardHandling] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]

New-CMGlobalCondition -DataType <GlobalConditionDataType> [-Description <String>]
 -DeviceType <GlobalConditionDeviceType> [-Is64Bit <Boolean>] -KeyName <String> -Name <String>
 -RegistryHive <RegistryRootKey> -ValueName <String> [-DisableWildcardHandling] [-ForceWildcardHandling]
 [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]

New-CMGlobalCondition -DataType <GlobalConditionDataType> [-Description <String>]
 -DeviceType <GlobalConditionDeviceType> -FilePath <String> -Name <String> -ScriptLanguage <ScriptingLanguage>
 [-Use32BitHost <Boolean>] [-UseLoggedOnUserCredential <Boolean>] [-DisableWildcardHandling]
 [-ForceWildcardHandling] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]

New-CMGlobalCondition -DataType <GlobalConditionDataType> [-Description <String>]
 -DeviceType <GlobalConditionDeviceType> -FilePath <String> [-IncludeSubfolder <Boolean>] [-Is64Bit <Boolean>]
 -Name <String> [-XmlNamespace <String[]>] -XPathQuery <String> [-DisableWildcardHandling]
 [-ForceWildcardHandling] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]

New-CMGlobalCondition -DataType <GlobalConditionDataType> [-Description <String>]
 -DeviceType <GlobalConditionDeviceType> -FilePath <String> [-IncludeSubfolder <Boolean>] [-Is64Bit <Boolean>]
 -Name <String> -XmlFilePath <String> [-XmlNamespace <String[]>] [-DisableWildcardHandling]
 [-ForceWildcardHandling] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]

New-CMGlobalCondition -DataType <GlobalConditionDataType> [-Description <String>]
 -DeviceType <GlobalConditionDeviceType> -Name <String> -OmaUri <String> [-DisableWildcardHandling]
 [-ForceWildcardHandling] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]

New-CMGlobalCondition [-Description <String>] -DeviceType <GlobalConditionDeviceType>
 -FileOrFolderName <String> [-IncludeSubfolder <Boolean>] [-Is64Bit <Boolean>] [-IsFolder] -Name <String>
 -Path <String> [-DisableWildcardHandling] [-ForceWildcardHandling] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]

New-CMGlobalCondition [-Description <String>] -DeviceType <GlobalConditionDeviceType> -FilePath <String>
 [-IncludeSubfolder <Boolean>] [-Is64Bit <Boolean>] -Name <String> [-DisableWildcardHandling]

parameters.name: AllInstances
parameters.description: Indicates that the global condition searches all database instances. To search a named instance, specify the *InstanceName* parameter. To search the default instance, specify the *UseDefaultInstance* parameter.

parameters.name: AssemblyName
parameters.description: Specifies the name of an assembly for which to search. An assembly name must be registered in the Global Assembly Cache.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Specifies a Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) class used to build a WMI Query Language (WQL) query. The query assesses compliance on client computers.

parameters.name: Column
parameters.description: Specifies the column name used to assess the compliance of the global condition.

parameters.name: Database
parameters.description: Specifies the name of a database. The SQL query runs on this database.

parameters.name: DataType
parameters.description: Specifies the global condition data type. The acceptable values for this parameter are: - Boolean - DateTime - FloatingPoint - Integer - IntegerArray - String - StringArray - Version

parameters.name: DefaultInstance
parameters.description: Indicates that the global condition searches the default database instance. To search a named instance, specify the *InstanceName* parameter. To search all instances, specify the *UseAllInstances* parameter.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Specifies a description for the global condition.

parameters.name: DeviceType
parameters.description: Specifies the type of device to which this global condition applies. The acceptable values for this parameter are: Nokia, Windows, and WindowsMobile.

parameters.name: DisableWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: DistinguishedName
parameters.description: Specifies the distinguished name of the Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) object to assess for compliance on client computers.

parameters.name: FileOrFolderName
parameters.description: Specifies the name of a file or folder. Specify the *IsFolder* parameter to search for a folder.

parameters.name: FilePath
parameters.description: Specifies a file path for the file that the condition assesses for compliance.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: IncludeSubfolder
parameters.description: Indicates whether the cmdlet includes subfolders in the operation.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: Specifies the name of a database instance that the global condition searches. To search the default instance, specify the *UseDefaultInstance* parameter. To search all instances, specify the *UseAllInstances* parameter.

parameters.name: Is64Bit
parameters.description: Indicates that the global condition searches the 64-bit system file location in addition to the 32-bit system file location.

parameters.name: IsFolder
parameters.description: Indicates that the global condition searches for a folder. If you do not select this parameter, the condition searches for a file. Specify the name of the file or folder by using the *FileOrFolderName* parameter.

parameters.name: KeyName
parameters.description: Specifies the registry key name for which to search. Use the format key\subkey.

parameters.name: LdapFilter
parameters.description: Specifies a Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) filter to refine the results from the AD DS query to assess compliance on client computers.

parameters.name: LdapPrefix
parameters.description: Specifies a valid LDAP prefix for the AD DS query that assesses compliance on client computers. This prefix can be either LDAP:// or GC://.

parameters.name: MetabasePath
parameters.description: Specifies the path to the metabase file for Internet Information Services (IIS).

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Specifies the name of an IIS metabase file.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: Specifies a namespace from a WMI repository. The default value is Root\cimv2.

parameters.name: OmaUri
parameters.description: Specifies a Uniform Resource Indicator (URI) that points to device-specific parameters for an Open Mobile Alliance (OMA) device.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: Specifies the path for an OMA URI.

parameters.name: Property
parameters.description: Specifies the property of the AD DS object used to assess compliance on client computers.

parameters.name: PropertyId
parameters.description: Specifies the property of AD DS that Configuration Manager uses to determine client compliance.

parameters.name: RegistryHive
parameters.description: Specifies the root key in the registry that identifies the registry hive that you search. WMI uses the registry hive to return, set, and change the values of registry keys. The acceptable values for this parameter are: - ClassesRoot - CurrentConfig - CurrentUser - LocalMachine - Users

parameters.name: ScriptLanguage
parameters.description: Specifies a scripting language to use. The acceptable values for this parameter are: - PowerShell - VBScript - JScript

parameters.name: SearchScope
parameters.description: Specifies the search scope in AD DS. The acceptable values for this parameter are: Base, OneLevel, and Subtree.

parameters.name: Use32BitHost
parameters.description: Indicates that the file or folder is associated with a 64-bit application.

parameters.name: UseLoggedOnUserCredential
parameters.description: Indicates whether to use logged on user credentials.

parameters.name: ValueName
parameters.description: Specifies the value to be contained in the specified registry key.

parameters.name: WhereClause
parameters.description: Specifies a WQL query WHERE clause to apply to the specified namespace, class, and property on client computers.

parameters.name: XmlFilePath
parameters.description: Specifies a file that contains the XML query to use to assess compliance on client computers.

parameters.name: XmlNamespace
parameters.description: Specifies an array of valid, full XML path language (XPath) queries to use to assess compliance on client computers.

parameters.name: XPathQuery
parameters.description: Specifies a XPath query.

parameters.description: Specify an integer value for the orchestration group member timeout in minutes. This value is the time limit for a single device in the group to install the updates.

parameters.name: MemberResourceIds
parameters.description: Specify an array of resource IDs for the devices to add as members of this orchestration group. The resource ID is an integer, for example, 16777220. It's the ResourceId property on a device or resource object. To get a device object, use the Get-CMDevice or Get-CMResource cmdlets. When you set the OrchestrationType parameter to Sequence, use this parameter to determine the order.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Specify a name for the orchestration group.

parameters.name: OrchestrationTimeOutMin
parameters.description: Specify an integer value for the orchestration group timeout in minutes. This value is the time limit for all group members to install the updates.

parameters.name: OrchestrationType
parameters.description: Specify one of the following values for the type of orchestration group: - Number: Allow a number of the devices to update at the same time. Use this setting to always limit to a specific number of devices, whatever the overall size of the orchestration group. To specify the number of devices, use the OrchestrationValue parameter. - Percentage: Allow a percentage of the devices to update at the same time. Use this setting to allow for future flexibility of the size of the orchestration group. To specify the percentage, use the OrchestrationValue parameter. - Sequence: Explicitly define the order in which devices run the software update deployment. The order is determined by the sort of the device resource IDs in the MemberResourceIds parameter.

parameters.name: OrchestrationValue
parameters.description: Specify an integer for the number or percentage of devices to update at the same time. Use this parameter when you set the OrchestrationType parameter to Number or Percentage.

parameters.name: PostScript
parameters.description: Specify the PowerShell script to run on each device _after_ the deployment runs and the device restarts, if required. This string value is the text of the script itself. If you have a script in a file that you want to use, first read it into a variable. For example, use the built-in Get-Content cmdlet. The scripts should return a value of 0 for success. Any non-zero value is considered a script failure. You can't use a script with parameters. The maximum script length is 50,000 characters.

parameters.name: PostScriptTimeoutSec

parameters.name: PreScriptTimeoutSec
parameters.description: Specify the integer value for the allowed time in seconds for the pre-script to run before it times out.

parameters.name: AssetTag
parameters.description: Specify an Asset tag for the Computer rule type. The maximum value is 255 characters. For example, if you set this value to 123456, it adds the following rule: IF Asset tag equals "123456" THEN

parameters.name: DefaultGateway
parameters.description: Specify the Default gateway for the Location rule type. For example, if you set this value to 192.168.10.1, it adds the following rule: IF Default gateway equals "192.168.10.1" THEN

parameters.name: DisableWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: MacAddress
parameters.description: Specify the MAC address for the Computer rule type. For example, if you set this value to 00:11:22:33:44:55, it adds the following rule: IF MAC address equals "00:11:22:33:44:55" THEN

parameters.name: Make
parameters.description: Specify the Make for the Make and Model rule type. To set the other value, use the Model parameter. The rule evaluates true when both values are true. You can use wildcard characters: - *: Multiple characters - ?: Single character For example, if you set this value to Surface and the Model to *, it adds the following rule: IF Make equals "Surface" AND Model equals "*" THEN

parameters.name: Model
parameters.description: Specify the Model for the Make and Model rule type. To set the other value, use the Make parameter. The rule evaluates true when both values are true. You can use wildcard characters: - *: Multiple characters - ?: Single character For example, if you set this value to * and the Make to Surface, it adds the following rule: IF Make equals "Surface" AND Model equals "*" THEN

parameters.name: ReferencedVariableName
parameters.description: Specify the Variable for the Task Sequence Variable rule type. It requires that you also set the ReferencedVariableOperator and ReferencedVariableValue parameters. This variable name can be a built-in task sequence variable or a custom one that you created. For more information, see How to use task sequence variables in Configuration Manager. For example, if you set the following values: - ReferencedVariableName: OSDRegisteredOrgName - ReferencedVariableOperator: Equals - ReferencedVariableValue: Contoso Then it adds the following rule: IF OSDRegisteredOrgName equals "Contoso" THEN

parameters.name: ReferencedVariableOperator
parameters.description: Specify the Condition for the Task Sequence Variable rule type. It requires that you also set the ReferencedVariableName and ReferencedVariableValue parameters. For the available operators, see the list of accepted values for this parameter. For example, if you set the following values: - ReferencedVariableName: OSDRegisteredOrgName - ReferencedVariableOperator: Equals - ReferencedVariableValue: Contoso Then it adds the following rule: IF OSDRegisteredOrgName equals "Contoso" THEN

parameters.name: ReferencedVariableValue
parameters.description: Specify the Value for the Task Sequence Variable rule type. It requires that you also set the ReferencedVariableName and ReferencedVariableOperator parameters. For example, if you set the following values: - ReferencedVariableName: OSDRegisteredOrgName - ReferencedVariableOperator: Equals - ReferencedVariableValue: Contoso Then it adds the following rule: IF OSDRegisteredOrgName equals "Contoso" THEN

parameters.name: SerialNumber
parameters.description: Specify a Serial number for the Computer rule type. For example, if you set this value to 123456, it adds the following rule: IF Asset tag equals "123456" THEN

parameters.name: Uuid
parameters.description: Specify a UUID for the Computer rule type. For example, if you set this value to de5ba380-f692-45e0-bbd3-0e40543b549e, it adds the following rule: IF UUID equals "de5ba380-f692-45e0-bbd3-0e40543b549e" THEN

parameters.name: Destination
parameters.description: Specify the location where you want to apply this data image. If you don't specify this parameter, the default is NextAvailableFormattedPartition. - NextAvailableFormattedPartition: Use the next sequential partition not already targeted by an Apply Operating System or Apply Data Image step in this task sequence. - SpecificDiskAndPartition: Specify the disk number with the DestinationDisk parameter and the partition number with the DestinationPartition parameter. - SpecificLogicalDriverLetter: Use the DestinationDriveLetter parameter to specify the logical drive letter assigned to the partition by Windows PE. This drive letter can be different from the drive letter assigned by the newly deployed OS. - LogicalDriverLetterInVariable: Use the DestinationVariable parameter to specify the task sequence variable containing the drive letter assigned to the partition by Windows PE. This variable is typically set with the DiskNumberVariable parameter of the Set-CMTSStepPartitionDisk or New-CMTSStepPartitionDisk cmdlets for the Format and Partition Disk task sequence step.

parameters.name: DestinationDriveLetter

parameters.name: DestinationPartition
parameters.description: When you use -Destination SpecificDiskAndPartition, use this parameter to specify the partition number. Specify an integer from 1 to 99. Also use the DestinationDisk parameter.

parameters.name: DestinationVariable

parameters.description: Applies to version 2006 and later. Set this parameter to true to skip this step for computers that don't have a TPM or when the TPM isn't enabled.

parameters.description: Add this parameter to use full disk encryption. By default, the Enable BitLocker step only encrypts used space on the drive.

parameters.name: TpmAndPin
parameters.description: Add this parameter to configure key management for the OS drive to use a TPM and a personal identification number (PIN). When you specify this option, BitLocker locks the normal boot process until the user provides the PIN. If you use this parameter, use Pin to specify the PIN value. You can't combine this parameter with TpmAndUsb, TpmOnly, or UsbOnly.

parameters.name: TpmAndUsb
parameters.description: Add this parameter to configure key management for the OS drive to use a TPM and a startup key stored on a USB flash drive. When you select this option, BitLocker locks the normal boot process until a USB device that contains a BitLocker startup key is attached to the computer. You can't combine this parameter with TpmAndPin, TpmOnly, or UsbOnly.

parameters.name: TpmOnly
parameters.description: Add this parameter to configure key management for the OS drive to only use a TPM. You can't combine this parameter with TpmAndPin, TpmAndUsb, or UsbOnly.

parameters.name: UsbOnly
parameters.description: Add this parameter to configure key management for the OS drive to only use a startup key stored on a USB flash drive. When you select this option, BitLocker locks the normal boot process until a USB device that contains a BitLocker startup key is attached to the computer. You can't combine this parameter with TpmAndPin, TpmAndUsb, or TpmOnly.

parameters.name: WaitForBitLockerComplete
parameters.description: Add this parameter to configure the step to wait for BitLocker to complete the drive encryption process on all drives before continuing task sequence execution.

parameters.name: AlertTime
parameters.description: Specifies an integer offset from an update deployment deadline. The rule uses this value to specify when the rule generates alerts. Specify a time unit by using the *AlertTimeUnit* parameter.

parameters.name: AlertTimeUnit
parameters.description: Specifies a unit of time for the *AlertTime* parameter. Valid values are: - Hours - Days - Weeks - Months

parameters.name: AllowRestart
parameters.description: Indicates whether a system restart is allowed to be performed outside of any defined maintenance windows when the installation deadline is reached.

parameters.name: AllowSoftwareInstallationOutsideMaintenanceWindow
parameters.description: Indicates whether software installation is allowed to be performed outside of any defined maintenance windows when the installation deadline is reached.

parameters.name: AllowUseMeteredNetwork
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow clients to download content over a metered Internet connection after the deadline, which may incur additional expense.

parameters.name: AvailableImmediately
parameters.description: Indicates whether software updates are available to install as soon as possible after the rule is run.

parameters.name: AvailableTime
parameters.description: Specify when software updates are available.

parameters.name: AvailableTimeUnit
parameters.description: Specifies the time unit type for the software available time. Valid values are: - Hours - Days - Weeks - Months

parameters.name: Collection
parameters.description: Specifies the target device collection object to be used for the servicing plan. To obtain a device collection object, use the Get-CMCollection or Get-CMDeviceCollection cmdlets.

parameters.name: CollectionId
parameters.description: Specifies the ID of the target device collection to be used for the servicing plan.

parameters.name: CollectionName
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the target device collection to be used for the servicing plan.

parameters.name: DeadlineImmediately
parameters.description: Indicates whether required software updates are installed as soon as possible when the deadline is reached.

parameters.name: DeadlineTime
parameters.description: Specifies the number of time units for the deadline.

parameters.name: DeadlineTimeUnit
parameters.description: Specifies the time unit type for the deadline. Valid values are: - Hours - Days - Weeks - Months

parameters.name: DeploymentPackage
parameters.description: Specifies a software update deployment package. To obtain a software update deployment package, use the Get-CMSoftwareUpdateDeploymentPackage cmdlet.

parameters.name: DeploymentRing
parameters.description: Specifies the Windows readiness state to which the servicing plan should apply. Valid values are: - CB - Release - BusinessMainstream - Cbb - Ltsb

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Specifies a description for the servicing plan.

parameters.name: DisableOperationManager
parameters.description: Indicates whether to disable System Center Operations Manager alerts during software updates.

parameters.name: DownloadFromInternet
parameters.description: Indicates whether to download software updates from the Internet.

parameters.name: DownloadFromMicrosoftUpdate
parameters.description: Indicates whether computers download content from Microsoft Update if the software updates are unavailable on a preferred distribution point or remote distribution point.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Indicates whether the servicing plan is enabled.

parameters.name: GenerateOperationManagerAlert
parameters.description: Indicates whether to generate Operations Manager alerts during a software update.

parameters.name: GenerateSuccessAlert
parameters.description: Indicates whether to generate an alert for successful deployment.

parameters.name: Language
parameters.description: Specifies an array of languages used to filter software upgrades that will be added to the service plan.

parameters.name: LanguageSelection
parameters.description: Specifies an array of languages, as strings. Computers download software updates available in the specified languages, in addition to non-language-specific updates.

parameters.name: Location
parameters.description: Specifies a network location to where the downloaded updates are located.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Specifies a name for the servicing plan. The name must be unique, help to describe the objective of the rule, and identify it from others in the Configuration Manager site.

parameters.name: NoInstallOnRemote
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow installation of updates on remote systems. If you specify a value of $True, if the client is within a slow or unreliable network boundary, or when the client uses a fallback source location for content, then Configuration Manager does not install software updates. If you specify a value of $False, installation proceeds.

parameters.name: NoInstallOnUnprotected
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow installation of updates on unprotected systems. If you specify a value of $True, if software updates are not available on any preferred distribution points, Configuration Manager does not download and install software updates. If you specify a value of $False, installation proceeds.

parameters.name: Required
parameters.description: Specifies an array of search strings used to filter software upgrades that will be added to the service plan.

parameters.name: RunType
parameters.description: Specifies the mode in which an update runs. Valid values are: - DoNotRunThisRuleAutomatically - RunTheRuleAfterAnySoftwareUpdatePointSynchronization - RunTheRuleOnSchedule

parameters.name: Schedule
parameters.description: Specifies the deadline time (from deployment available time). To create a schedule, use the New-CMSchedule cmdlet.

parameters.name: SendWakeupPacket
parameters.description: Indicates whether to send a wake-up packet to computers before the deployment begins. If this value is $True, Configuration Manager wakes a computer from sleep. If this value is $False, it does not wake computers from sleep. For computers to wake, you must first configure Wake On LAN.

parameters.name: SuccessPercentage
parameters.description: Specifies a percentage for client compliance as an integer from 0 to 99. If compliance falls below this percentage, Configuration Manager produces optional alerts.

parameters.name: SuppressRestartServer
parameters.description: Indicates whether a system restart is suppressed on servers when a software update requires a system restart to complete the installation process.

parameters.name: SuppressRestartWorkstation
parameters.description: Indicates whether a system restart is suppressed on workstations when a software update requires a system restart to complete the installation process.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Specifies an array of search strings used to filter software update titles that will be added to the service plan.

parameters.name: UpdateDeploymentWaitDay
parameters.description: Specifies the number of days to wait after Microsoft has published a new upgrade before deploying in your environment.

parameters.name: UseBranchCache
parameters.description: Indicates whether to use a branch cache. If you specify a value of $True, clients share content on the same subnet.

parameters.name: UserNotification
parameters.description: Specifies the notification behavior of the user visual experience. Valid values are: - DisplayAll - DisplaySoftwareCenterOnly - HideAll

parameters.name: UseUtc
parameters.description: Indicates whether the schedule for this deployment is evaluated based upon Universal Coordinated Time (UTC).

parameters.name: VerboseLevel
parameters.description: Specifies the level of detail you want clients to report for deployments that this rule creates. Valid values are: - AllMessages - OnlyErrorMessages - OnlySuccessAndErrorMessages

parameters.name: WriteFilterHandling
parameters.description: Indicates whether changes are committed at deadline or during a maintenance window (requires restarts). If set to $False, content is applied on the overlay and committed later.

Set-CMDiscoveryMethod.syntax:
Set-CMDiscoveryMethod [-ActiveDirectoryForestDiscovery] [-EnableActiveDirectorySiteBoundaryCreation <Boolean>]
 [-Enabled <Boolean>] [-EnableSubnetBoundaryCreation <Boolean>] [-PassThru] [-PollingSchedule <IResultObject>]
 [-SiteCode <String>] [-DisableWildcardHandling] [-ForceWildcardHandling] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm]
 [<CommonParameters>]

Set-CMDiscoveryMethod [-ActiveDirectoryContainer <String[]>] [-ActiveDirectorySystemDiscovery]
 [-AddActiveDirectoryContainer <String[]>] [-AddAdditionalAttribute <String[]>]
 [-ClearActiveDirectoryContainer] [-DeltaDiscoveryMins <Int32>] [-Enabled <Boolean>]
 [-EnableDeltaDiscovery <Boolean>] [-EnableFilteringExpiredLogon <Boolean>]
 [-EnableFilteringExpiredPassword <Boolean>] [-EnableIncludeGroup <Boolean>] [-EnableRecursive <Boolean>]
 [-IncludeGroup] [-PassThru] [-PollingSchedule <IResultObject>] [-Recursive]
 [-RemoveActiveDirectoryContainer <String[]>] [-RemoveAdditionalAttribute <String[]>] [-SiteCode <String>]
 [-TimeSinceLastLogonDays <Int32>] [-TimeSinceLastPasswordUpdateDays <Int32>] [-UserName <String>]
 [-DisableWildcardHandling] [-ForceWildcardHandling] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]

Set-CMDiscoveryMethod [-ActiveDirectoryContainer <String[]>] [-ActiveDirectoryUserDiscovery]
 [-AddActiveDirectoryContainer <String[]>] [-AddAdditionalAttribute <String[]>]
 [-ClearActiveDirectoryContainer] [-DeltaDiscoveryMins <Int32>] [-Enabled <Boolean>]
 [-EnableDeltaDiscovery <Boolean>] [-EnableIncludeGroup <Boolean>] [-EnableRecursive <Boolean>] [-IncludeGroup]
 [-PassThru] [-PollingSchedule <IResultObject>] [-Recursive] [-RemoveActiveDirectoryContainer <String[]>]
 [-RemoveAdditionalAttribute <String[]>] [-SiteCode <String>] [-UserName <String>] [-DisableWildcardHandling]
 [-ForceWildcardHandling] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]

Set-CMDiscoveryMethod [-ActiveDirectoryGroupDiscovery] [-AddGroupDiscoveryScope <ADGroupDiscoveryScope[]>]
 [-ClearActiveDirectoryContainer] [-DeltaDiscoveryMins <Int32>]
 [-DiscoverDistributionGroupMembership <Boolean>] [-Enabled <Boolean>] [-EnableDeltaDiscovery <Boolean>]
 [-EnableFilteringExpiredLogon <Boolean>] [-EnableFilteringExpiredPassword <Boolean>] [-PassThru]
 [-PollingSchedule <IResultObject>] [-RemoveGroupDiscoveryScope <String[]>] [-SiteCode <String>]
 [-TimeSinceLastLogonDays <Int32>] [-TimeSinceLastPasswordUpdateDays <Int32>] [-DisableWildcardHandling]
 [-ForceWildcardHandling] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]

Set-CMDiscoveryMethod [-Enabled <Boolean>] [-NetworkDiscovery] [-NetworkDiscoveryType <NetworkDiscoveryType>]
 [-PassThru] [-SiteCode <String>] [-SlowNetworkSpeed <Boolean>] [-DisableWildcardHandling]
 [-ForceWildcardHandling] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]

Set-CMDiscoveryMethod [-Enabled <Boolean>] [-Heartbeat] [-PassThru] [-PollingSchedule <IResultObject>]
 [-SiteCode <String>] [-DisableWildcardHandling] [-ForceWildcardHandling] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm]
 [<CommonParameters>]

parameters.name: ActiveDirectoryContainer
parameters.description: Specifies an array of names of Active Directory containers.

parameters.name: ActiveDirectoryForestDiscovery
parameters.description: Indicates that the discovery method discovers security groups, including local, global, and universal groups from specified locations in Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS).

parameters.name: ActiveDirectoryGroupDiscovery
parameters.description: Indicates that the discovery method discovers additional information, including the computer organizational unit (OU) and group membership, about previously discovered computers from specified locations in AD DS.

parameters.name: ActiveDirectorySystemDiscovery
parameters.description: Indicates that the discovery method discovers computers from specified locations in AD DS.

parameters.name: ActiveDirectoryUserDiscovery
parameters.description: Indicates that the discovery method discovers users from specified locations in AD DS.

parameters.name: AddAdditionalAttribute
parameters.description: Specifies an array of Active Directory object attributes. The cmdlet adds these attributes to the list of attributes that Configuration Manager discovers.

parameters.name: DisableWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: EnableActiveDirectorySiteBoundaryCreation
parameters.description: Indicates whether Configuration Manager creates Active Directory boundaries from AD DS discovery information.

parameters.name: Enabled
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the Configuration Manager discovery. If you specify a value of $False, Configuration Manager does not discover resources by using this discovery.

parameters.name: EnableDeltaDiscovery
parameters.description: Indicates whether Configuration Manager discovers resources created or modified in AD DS since the last discovery cycle. If you specify a value of $True for this parameter, specify a value for the *DeltaDiscoveryIntervalMinutes* parameter.

parameters.name: EnableFilteringExpiredLogon
parameters.description: Indicates whether Configuration Manager discovers only computers that have logged onto a domain within a specified number of days. Specify the number of days by using the *TimeSinceLastLogonDays* parameter.

parameters.name: EnableFilteringExpiredPassword
parameters.description: Indicates whether Configuration Manager discovers only computers that have updated their computer account password within a specified number of days. Specify the number of days by using the *TimeSinceLastPasswordUpdateDays* parameter.

parameters.name: EnableIncludeGroup
parameters.description: {{ Fill EnableIncludeGroup Description }}

parameters.name: EnableRecursive
parameters.description: {{ Fill EnableRecursive Description }}

parameters.name: EnableSubnetBoundaryCreation
parameters.description: Indicates whether Configuration Manager creates IP address range boundaries from AD DS discovery information.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: Heartbeat
parameters.description: Indicates that the discovery method updates discovery records for Configuration Manager clients in the Configuration Manager database without discovering new resources.

parameters.name: NetworkDiscovery
parameters.description: Indicates that the discovery method searches the network infrastructure for network devices, such as printers, routers, and bridges, that have IP addresses.

parameters.name: NetworkDiscoveryType
parameters.description: Specifies the network discovery type. If you specify the *NetworkDiscovery* parameter, specify one of the following types: - ToplogyAndClient. The discovery finds the topology of your network and potential client devices. - ToplogyClientAndClientOperatingSystem. The discovery finds the topology of your network. The discovery finds potential client devices and their operating systems and versions. - Topology. The discovery finds the topology of your network by discovering IP subnets and routers.

parameters.name: PassThru
parameters.description: Add this parameter to return an object that represents the item with which you're working. By default, this cmdlet may not generate any output.

parameters.name: PollingSchedule
parameters.description: Specifies a schedule object. To obtain a schedule object, use the New-CMSchedule cmdlet. The polling schedule determines how often Configuration Manager attempts to discover groups, systems, or user data.

parameters.name: RemoveAdditionalAttribute
parameters.description: Specifies an array of Active Directory object attributes. The cmdlet removes these attributes from the list of attributes that Configuration Manager discovers.

parameters.name: SiteCode
parameters.description: Specifies the site code for a Configuration Manager site.

parameters.name: SlowNetworkSpeed
parameters.description: Indicates whether Configuration Manager makes adjustments to its discovery settings for networks that have low bandwidth.

parameters.name: TimeSinceLastLogonDays
parameters.description: Specifies the number of days since the last logon when the *EnableFilteringExpiredLogon* parameter had a value of $True.

parameters.name: TimeSinceLastPasswordUpdateDays
parameters.description: Specifies the number of days since that last password updated when the *EnableFilteringExpiredPassword* parameter had a value of $True.

parameters.name: AccountUserNameType
parameters.description: Specifies an account user name type. Valid values are: - mail - sAMAccountName - userPrincipalName

parameters.name: AllowMessageMove

parameters.name: AllowThirdPartyApplication

parameters.name: MailSyncDays

parameters.name: SupportedPlatform

parameters.name: SyncContentType
parameters.description: Specifies a content type to synchronize to devices. Valid values are: - None - Email - Contacts - Calendar - Tasks - Notes - All

parameters.name: SynchronizeRecentlyUsed

parameters.name: SyncSchedule

$Gs= New-CMExchangeConnectorGeneralSetting -AllowInternetShare $True -AllowDesktopSync $True -AllowNonProvision $True -RefreshInterval 4
$Ps= New-CMExchangeConnectorPasswordSetting -PasswordEnabled $True -MinimumPasswordLength 8 -PasswordExpiration 51 -PasswordHistory 21 -WipeAfterFailedAttempt 6 -MaximumIdleTimeMinutes 41 -PasswordComplexity
$Em = New-CMExchangeConnectorEmailManagementSetting -ConsumerEmail $True -MaximumEmailAge OneDay -MaximumCalenderAge ThreeMonths -PushWhenRoaming $True -AllowHtmlEmail $True -EmailAttachmentPolicy $True -MaximumSizeTextEmail 401 -MaximumSizeHtmlEmail 402 -MaximumSizeAttachment 24
$Ss = New-CMExchangeConnectorSecuritySetting -RemoteDesktop $True -StorageCard $True -Camera $True -Bluetooth $False -WiFiConnection HandsfreeOnly -Infra $False -Browser $False -StorageCardEncrypt $False -FileEncrypt $False -TextMessage $False

parameters.name: AccessLevel
parameters.description: Specifies the type of access for the mobile devices. Access level applies to a mobile device that is not managed by a rule. Valid values are: - Allow - Block - Quarantine

parameters.name: ActiveDirectoryContainer
parameters.description: Specifies an array of names of Active Directory containers. When this parameter appears, the Exchange Server connector searches for the device only in the Active Directory containers.

parameters.name: AllowExternalDeviceManagement
parameters.description: Indicates whether an external device management program can manage the device.

parameters.name: ApplicationSetting
parameters.description: Specifies application settings, such as allow or deny the installation of applications. For each dictionary entry in the array, specify the setting name as the key the configuration as the value. Valid values are: AllowUnsignedApplications, AllowUnsignedInstallationPackages, or Block a specific application.

parameters.name: DisableWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: EmailAddress
parameters.description: Specifies an array of email addresses.

parameters.name: EmailManagementSetting
parameters.description: Specifies email management settings, such as synchronization schedule, message format, and size of attachments. For each dictionary entry in the array, specify the setting name as the key and the configuration as the value.

parameters.name: EnableAccessRule
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable an access rule.

parameters.name: ExchangeClientAccessServer
parameters.description: Specifies Exchange Client Access servers, as key-value pairs.

parameters.name: FindAll
parameters.description: Indicates that the discovery process find all mobile devices in an Exchange organization.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: FullSyncSchedule
parameters.description: Specifies a result object that schedules the full discovery time for an Exchange Server connector.

parameters.name: GeneralSetting
parameters.description: Specifies general settings for mobile devices that use the Exchange Server Connector. Settings you can specify for this parameter include: - RequireManualSyncWhenRoaming - RequireStorageCardEncryption - UnapprovedInROMApplicationList - DevicePolicyRefreshInterval - MaxInactivityTimeDeviceLock

parameters.name: IsHosted
parameters.description: Indicates that the Exchange Server connector configuration is for a hosted or on-premise Exchange Server.

parameters.name: NewServerAddress
parameters.description: Specifies a new server address for an Exchange server.

parameters.name: NotificationUserName

parameters.name: PasswordSetting
parameters.description: Specifies general password settings. Settings you can specify for this parameter include: - AlphanumericDevicePasswordRequired - DevicePasswordEnabled - DevicePasswordExpiration - DevicePasswordHistory - MaxDevicePasswordFailedAttempts - PasswordRecoveryEnabled - MinDevicePasswordComplexCharacters - MinDevicePasswordLength - AlphanumericDevicePasswordRequired - AllowSimpleDevicePassword

parameters.name: SecuritySetting
parameters.description: Specifies a dictionary of security settings. Settings you can specify for this parameter include: - AllowBluetooth - AllowBrowser - AllowCamera - AllowDesktopSync - AllowInternetSharing - AllowIrDA - AllowNonProvisionableDevices - AllowRemoteDesktop - AllowStorageCard - AllowTextMessaging - AllowWiFi

parameters.name: DestinationSiteCode

parameters.name: AssemblyName
parameters.description: Specifies the name of an assembly for which to search. An assembly name must be registered in the global assembly cache.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Specifies a Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) class used to build a WMI Query Language (WQL) query. The query assesses compliance on client computers.

parameters.name: Column
parameters.description: Specifies the column name used to assess the compliance of the global condition.

parameters.name: Database
parameters.description: Specifies the name of a database. The SQL query runs on this database.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Specifies a description for the global condition.

parameters.name: DisableWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: DistinguishedName
parameters.description: Specifies the distinguished name of the Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) object to assess for compliance on client computers.

parameters.name: FileOrFolderName
parameters.description: Specifies the name of a file or folder. Specify the *IsFolder* parameter to search for a folder.

parameters.name: FilePath
parameters.description: Specifies a file path for the file that the condition assesses for compliance.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: IncludeSubfolder
parameters.description: Indicates whether the cmdlet includes subfolders in the operation.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: Specifies the name of a database instance that the global condition searches. To search the default instance, specify the *UseDefaultInstance* parameter. To search all instances, specify the *UseAllInstances* parameter.

parameters.name: Is64Bit
parameters.description: Indicates that the global condition searches the 64-bit system file location in addition to the 32-bit system file location.

parameters.name: KeyName
parameters.description: Specifies the registry key name for which to search. Use the format key\subkey.

parameters.name: LdapFilter
parameters.description: Specifies a Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) filter to refine the results from the AD DS query to assess compliance on client computers.

parameters.name: LdapPrefix
parameters.description: Specifies a valid LDAP prefix for the AD DS query that assesses compliance on client computers. The acceptable values for this parameter are: LDAP:// or GC://.

parameters.name: MetabasePath
parameters.description: Specifies the path to the metabase file for Internet Information Services (IIS).

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the global conditions. This value corresponds to the LocalizedDisplayName property of a global condition object.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: Specifies a namespace from a WMI repository. The default value is Root\cimv2.

parameters.name: NewName
parameters.description: Specifies a new name for the global condition.

parameters.name: OmaUri
parameters.description: Specifies a Uniform Resource Indicator (URI) that points to device-specific parameters for an Open Mobile Alliance (OMA) device.

parameters.name: PassThru
parameters.description: Returns the current working object. By default, this cmdlet does not generate any output.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: Specifies the path for an OMA URI.

parameters.name: Property
parameters.description: Specifies the property of the AD DS object used to assess compliance on client computers.

parameters.name: PropertyId
parameters.description: Specifies the property of AD DS that Configuration Manager uses to determine client compliance.

parameters.name: RegistryHive
parameters.description: Specifies the root key in the registry that identifies the registry hive that you search. WMI uses the registry hive to return, set, and change the values of registry keys. The acceptable values for this parameter are: - ClassesRoot - CurrentConfig - CurrentUser - LocalMachine - Users

parameters.name: ScriptLanguage
parameters.description: Specifies a scripting language to use. The acceptable values for this parameter are: - PowerShell - VBScript - JScript

parameters.name: SearchScope
parameters.description: Specifies the search scope in AD DS. The acceptable values for this parameter are: - Base - OneLevel - Subtree

parameters.name: Use32BitHost
parameters.description: Indicates that the file or folder is associated with a 64-bit application.

parameters.name: UseAllInstances
parameters.description: Indicates that the global condition searches all database instances. To search a named instance, specify the *InstanceName* parameter. To search the default instance, specify the *UseDefaultInstance* parameter.

parameters.name: UseDefaultInstance
parameters.description: Indicates that the global condition searches the default database instance. To search a named instance, specify the *InstanceName* parameter. To search all instances, specify the *UseAllInstances* parameter.

parameters.description: Specifies a WQL query WHERE clause to apply to the specified namespace, class, and property on client computers.

parameters.name: XmlNamespace
parameters.description: Specifies an array of valid, full XML path language (XPath) queries to use to assess compliance on client computers.

parameters.name: ApplyTo
parameters.description: Specify the type of maintenance window: - Any: The maintenance window applies to all deployments. - SoftwareUpdatesOnly: The maintenance window only applies to software update deployments. - TaskSequencesOnly: The maintenance window only applies to task sequence deployments.

parameters.name: ApplyToSoftwareUpdateOnly
parameters.description: This parameter is deprecated. Use the ApplyTo parameter with the SoftwareUpdatesOnly value.

parameters.name: ApplyToTaskSequenceOnly
parameters.description: This parameter is deprecated. Use the ApplyTo parameter with the TaskSequencesOnly value.

parameters.name: CollectionId
parameters.description: Specify the ID of a collection to configure a maintenance window. This ID is a standard collection ID, for example XYZ0003F.

parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: IsEnabled
parameters.description: Use this parameter to configure if the maintenance window is active for the collection: - $true: Enable the maintenance window. Deployments only run during the window's schedule. - $false: Disable the maintenance window. Deployments run at any time as configured.

parameters.name: IsUtc
parameters.description: To configure the maintenance window schedule to use Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), set this parameter to $true.

parameters.name: MaintenanceWindow
parameters.description: Specify an maintenance window object to configure. To get this object, use the Get-CMMaintenanceWindow cmdlet.

parameters.name: Schedule
parameters.description: Specify a schedule object for when the maintenance window occurs. To get this object, use the New-CMSchedule cmdlet. The maintenance window object stores the schedule as a token string. To copy a schedule from another object, use the Convert-CMSchedule cmdlet. For example, Convert-CMSchedule -ScheduleString $mw1.ServiceWindowSchedules.

parameters.name: EnableScheduledMulticast
parameters.description: Indicates whether you can schedule when Configuration Manager deploys the operating system image from the distribution point.

parameters.name: EndIPAddress
parameters.description: Specifies the ending IP address in the range of IP addresses that Configuration Manager uses to send data to the destination computers.

parameters.name: EndUdpPort
parameters.description: Specifies the ending port in the range of user datagram protocol (UDP) ports that Configuration Manager uses to send data to the destination computers.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: InputObject
parameters.description: Specifies a multicast service point object. To obtain a multicast service point object, use the Get-CMMulticastServicePoint cmdlet.

parameters.name: MaximumClientCount
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum number of destination computers that can download the operating system from this distribution point.

parameters.name: MinimumClientCount
parameters.description: Specifies the minimum number of requests that must be received before Configuration Manager starts to deploy the operating system.

parameters.name: PassThru
parameters.description: Returns an object that represents the multicast service point. By default, this cmdlet does not generate any output.

parameters.name: SessionStartDelayMins
parameters.description: Specifies the number of minutes that Configuration Manager waits before it responds to the first deployment request.

parameters.name: SiteCode
parameters.description: Specifies the site code for the Configuration Manager site that hosts the site system role.

parameters.name: SiteSystemServerName
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the server that hosts a site system role.

parameters.name: StartIPAddress
parameters.description: Specifies the starting IP address in the range of IP addresses that Configuration Manager uses to send data to the destination computers.

parameters.name: StartUdpPort
parameters.description: Specifies the starting port in the range of UDP ports that Configuration Manager uses to send data to the destination computers.

parameters.name: UserName
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the user that the distribution site system components use to connect to the primary site database. If the *UserName* parameter is not specified, the cmdlet uses the computer account of the distribution point to the primary site database.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: Prompts you for confirmation before running the cmdlet.

parameters.name: AddSupportedPlatform
parameters.description: Specify a supported platform object to which this policy is applicable. To get this object, use the Get-CMSupportedPlatform cmdlet.

parameters.name: ClearSupportedPlatform
parameters.description: Add this parameter to clear the current list of supported platforms.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Specify an optional description for the OneDrive for Business policy to better identify it.

parameters.name: DisableWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: Specify the CI ID of the OneDrive for Business policy to configure. The format is a five- to seven-digit number, for example 403823.

parameters.name: InputObject
parameters.description: Specify a OneDrive for Business policy object to configure. To get this object, use the Get-CMOneDriveBusinessProfile cmdlet.

parameters.name: KnownFolderMoveOption
parameters.description: Specify how you want to move the known folders to OneDrive: - PromptToMove: Prompt users to move Windows known folders to OneDrive. The user sees a wizard to move their files. If they choose to postpone or decline moving their folders, OneDrive periodically reminds them. - SilentlyMove: Silently move Windows known folders to OneDrive. When this policy applies to the device, the OneDrive client automatically redirects the known folders to OneDrive for Business.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Specify the name of the OneDrive for Business policy to configure.

parameters.name: NewName
parameters.description: To rename this OneDrive for Business policy, specify a new name.

parameters.name: O365TenantId
parameters.description: Specify your Microsoft 365 tenant ID. Find your Microsoft 365 tenant ID.

parameters.name: PreventRedirectKnownFolders
parameters.description: Set this parameter to $true to prevent users from redirecting their Windows known folders back to their PC. It disables the option in OneDrive for Business on the client for users to move these folders back to the device.

parameters.name: RemoveSupportedPlatform
parameters.description: Specify a supported platform object to remove from this policy. To get this object, use the Get-CMSupportedPlatform cmdlet.

parameters.name: ShowNotification
parameters.description: When you use SilentlyMove for the KnownFolderMoveOption parameter, if you set this parameter to $true, the OneDrive client notifies the user after it moves their folders.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: Prompts you for confirmation before running the cmdlet.

parameters.name: WhatIf
parameters.description: Shows what would happen if the cmdlet runs. The cmdlet doesn't run.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Specify an optional description for the orchestration group to help identify it.

parameters.name: DisableWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: Specify the ID of orchestration group to configure. This value is the MOGID property, which is an integer. For example, 16777217.

parameters.name: InputObject
parameters.description: Specify an object for the orchestration group to configure. To get this object, use the Get-CMOrchestrationGroup cmdlet.

parameters.name: MaxLockTimeOutMin
parameters.description: Specify an integer value for the orchestration group member timeout in minutes. This value is the time limit for a single device in the group to install the updates.

parameters.name: MemberResourceIds
parameters.description: Specify an array of resource IDs for the devices to add as members of this orchestration group. The resource ID is an integer, for example, 16777220. It's the ResourceId property on a device or resource object. To get a device object, use the Get-CMDevice or Get-CMResource cmdlets. When you set the OrchestrationType parameter to Sequence, use this parameter to determine the order.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Specify the name of the orchestration group to configure.

parameters.name: NewName
parameters.description: Specify a new name for this orchestration group. Use this parameter to rename the orchestration group.

parameters.name: OrchestrationTimeOutMin
parameters.description: Specify an integer value for the orchestration group timeout in minutes. This value is the time limit for all group members to install the updates.

parameters.name: OrchestrationType
parameters.description: Specify one of the following values for the type of orchestration group: - Number: Allow a number of the devices to update at the same time. Use this setting to always limit to a specific number of devices, whatever the overall size of the orchestration group. To specify the number of devices, use the OrchestrationValue parameter. - Percentage: Allow a percentage of the devices to update at the same time. Use this setting to allow for future flexibility of the size of the orchestration group. To specify the percentage, use the OrchestrationValue parameter. - Sequence: Explicitly define the order in which devices run the software update deployment. The order is determined by the sort of the device resource IDs in the MemberResourceIds parameter.

parameters.name: OrchestrationValue
parameters.description: Specify an integer for the number or percentage of devices to update at the same time. Use this parameter when you set the OrchestrationType parameter to Number or Percentage.

parameters.name: PostScript
parameters.description: Specify the PowerShell script to run on each device _after_ the deployment runs and the device restarts, if required. This string value is the text of the script itself. If you have a script in a file that you want to use, first read it into a variable. For example, use the built-in Get-Content cmdlet. The scripts should return a value of 0 for success. Any non-zero value is considered a script failure. You can't use a script with parameters. The maximum script length is 50,000 characters.

parameters.name: PostScriptTimeoutSec
parameters.description: Specify the integer value for the allowed time in seconds for the post-script to run before it times out.

parameters.name: PreScript
parameters.description: Specify the PowerShell script to run on each device _before_ the deployment runs. This string value is the text of the script itself. If you have a script in a file that you want to use, first read it into a variable. For example, use the built-in Get-Content cmdlet. The scripts should return a value of 0 for success. Any non-zero value is considered a script failure. You can't use a script with parameters. The maximum script length is 50,000 characters.

parameters.name: PreScriptTimeoutSec
parameters.description: Specify the integer value for the allowed time in seconds for the pre-script to run before it times out.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: Prompts you for confirmation before running the cmdlet.

parameters.name: WhatIf
parameters.description: Shows what would happen if the cmdlet runs. The cmdlet doesn't run.

parameters.name: AddSupportedOperatingSystemPlatform
parameters.description: Specify one or more supported OS platforms to add for the program. To get this object, use the Get-CMSupportedPlatform cmdlet.

parameters.name: AfterRunningType
parameters.description: Specify the action that occurs after the program completes successfully.

parameters.name: Category
parameters.description: Specify the category under which the program is displayed on the client computer.

parameters.name: CommandLine
parameters.description: Specify the command line for the program.

parameters.name: CommandLineFolder
parameters.description: Specify the folder that contains the executable program. This folder can be an absolute path on the client, or a path relative to the distribution folder that contains the package.

parameters.name: Comment
parameters.description: Specify optional text about the program, such as a description. On client computers, this text displays with the program in Software Center.

parameters.name: DeviceProgram
parameters.description: Add this parameter to configure this program as a device program.

parameters.name: DisableMomAlertOnRun
parameters.description: Indicates whether the computer running the program is in maintenance mode for the duration of the program. When in maintenance mode, System Center Operations Manager disables alerts while the program runs.

parameters.name: DisableProgram
parameters.description: Set this parameter to $true to temporarily disable all deployments that contain this program. You can also use the Disable-CMProgram cmdlet.

parameters.name: DisableWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: DiskSpaceRequirement
parameters.description: Specify the amount of disk space that the software program requires to run on the computer. The value must be greater than or equal to zero. If you specify a value, use the DiskSpaceUnit parameter to specify units for the value.

parameters.name: DiskSpaceUnit
parameters.description: Specify an accepted unit for the DiskSpaceRequirement parameter.

parameters.name: DownloadProgramType
parameters.description: Specify when the program is to run.

parameters.name: DriveLetter
parameters.description: If you use the DriveMode parameter, specify a drive letter for the location.

parameters.name: DriveMode
parameters.description: Indicates whether the program requires a specific drive letter, specified in the DriveLetter parameter. - RunWithUnc: Run the program from the UNC path. This value is the default. Starting in version 2010, this value was renamed from RenameWithUnc. - RequiresDriveLetter: The program uses any available drive letter. - RequiresSpecificDriveLetter: The program only runs if the drive isn't already in use.

parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum amount of time that you expect the program to run. The default value is 120 minutes.

parameters.name: EnableTaskSequence
parameters.description: Indicates whether this program can be installed from the Install Package task sequence step.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: GenerateMomAlertOnFail
parameters.description: Indicates whether Configuration Manager generates an application log event entry if the program fails.

parameters.name: InputObject
parameters.description: Specify a program object to configure. To get this object, use the Get-CMProgram cmdlet.

parameters.name: PackageId
parameters.description: Specify a package ID with the program to configure.

parameters.name: PackageName
parameters.description: Specify a package name with the program to configure.

parameters.name: PassThru
parameters.description: Returns an object representing the item with which you're working. By default, this cmdlet may not generate any output.

parameters.name: ProgramAssignedType
parameters.description: Specify whether the program runs once on the computer, or once for every user who signs in to the computer. The default value is RunOnceForTheComputer. The program is only assigned to users when the ProgramRunType parameter is set to OnlyWhenUserIsLoggedOn.

parameters.name: ProgramName
parameters.description: Specify the name of the program to configure.

parameters.name: ProgramRunType
parameters.description: Specify the logon conditions that are necessary for the program to run. The default value is OnlyWhenUserIsLoggedOn.

parameters.name: Reconnect
parameters.description: Indicates whether the client computer reconnects to the distribution point when the user signs in.

parameters.name: RemoveSupportedOperatingSystemPlatform
parameters.description: Specify one or more supported OS platforms to remove for the program. To get this object, use the Get-CMSupportedPlatform cmdlet.

parameters.name: Requirement
parameters.description: Specify any additional requirements for standard or device programs.

parameters.name: RunMode
parameters.description: Specify the credentials the client computer requires to run the program.

parameters.name: RunOnAnyPlatform
parameters.description: Add this parameter to clear all supported OS platforms from this program.

parameters.name: RunType
parameters.description: Specify the mode in which the program runs on the client computer. The default value is Normal.

parameters.name: StandardProgram
parameters.description: Indicates that the program type in the deployment package is standard program.

parameters.name: SuppressProgramNotification
parameters.description: Set this parameter to $true to suppress program notifications.

parameters.name: UserInteraction
parameters.description: Indicates whether to allow users to interact with the program.

parameters.name: WorkingDirectory
parameters.description: Specify a working directory for the program.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: Prompts you for confirmation before running the cmdlet.

parameters.name: WhatIf
parameters.description: Shows what would happen if the cmdlet runs. The cmdlet doesn't run.

parameters.name: DisableWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: InputObject
parameters.description: Specifies a service connection point object. To obtain a service connection point object, use the Get-CMServiceConnectionPoint cmdlet.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Specifies a mode for the service connection point. Valid values are: - Online - Offline

parameters.name: PassThru
parameters.description: Add this parameter to return an object that represents the item with which you're working. By default, this cmdlet may not generate any output.

parameters.name: SiteCode
parameters.description: Specifies the site code for a Configuration Manager site.

parameters.name: SiteSystemServerName
parameters.description: Specifies the name of a site system server that hosts the service connection point role.

parameters.description: Prompts you for confirmation before running the cmdlet.

parameters.name: WhatIf
parameters.description: Shows what would happen if the cmdlet runs. The cmdlet doesn't run.

parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.
