parameters.name: Comment
parameters.description: Specifies a comment for a software metering rule.

parameters.name: DisableWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: Specifies the filename of the software that a rule meters.

parameters.name: FileVersion
parameters.description: Specifies a version of the software that a rule meters.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: Specifies an array of IDs for software metering rules.

parameters.name: InputObject
parameters.description: Specifies a software metering rule object. To obtain a software metering rule object, use the Get-CMSoftwareMeteringRule cmdlet.

parameters.name: LanguageId
parameters.description: Specifies a LocaleID of the software that a rule meters. For more information and a list of locale identifiers, see Appendix A: Product Behavior.

parameters.name: NewProductName
parameters.description: Specifies a new name for the software that a rule meters.

parameters.name: OriginalFileName
parameters.description: Specifies an original file name of the software that a rule meters. This parameter can differ from the *FileName* parameter if a user changed the name.

parameters.name: PassThru
parameters.description: Add this parameter to return an object that represents the item with which you're working. By default, this cmdlet may not generate any output.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: Specifies a file path of the software that a rule meters.

parameters.name: ProductName
parameters.description: Specifies a name for a product that a rule meters.

parameters.name: SiteCode
parameters.description: Specifies a site code of a Configuration Manager site.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: Prompts you for confirmation before running the cmdlet.

parameters.name: WhatIf
parameters.description: Shows what would happen if the cmdlet runs. The cmdlet doesn't run.

parameters.name: AutoCreateDisabledRule
parameters.description: Specifies whether Configuration Manager automatically creates software metering rules. If this value is $True, Configuration Manager automatically creates software metering rules. If this value is $False, it does not automatically create rules. When Configuration Manager creates rules, it creates them as disabled. You can use the values set by other parameters of this cmdlet to limit creation of rules.

parameters.name: AutoCreatePercentage
parameters.description: Specifies a percentage of computers that use a piece of software for Configuration Manager to create a rule. Software metering calculates the number of computers as all the computers monitored for software metering by Configuration Manager, not just for a single site. Valid values are integers from 1 through 99.

parameters.name: AutoCreateThreshold
parameters.description: Specifies a number of software metering rules as a threshold. When Configuration Manager exceeds this threshold, it stops automatically creating rules. The number of rules counted for this threshold includes all software metering rules, not only those that Configuration Manager creates automatically. Valid values are integers from 1 through 1000.

parameters.name: DataRetentionDayCount
parameters.description: Specifies the number of days that Configuration Manager keeps software metering data.

parameters.name: DisableWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: Prompts you for confirmation before running the cmdlet.

parameters.name: WhatIf
parameters.description: Shows what would happen if the cmdlet runs. The cmdlet doesn't run.

parameters.name: ComponentName
parameters.description: Specifies the Configuration Manager component that corresponds to the status messages.

parameters.name: DisableWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: ForwardToStatusSummarizer
parameters.description: Indicates whether to forward to the status summarizer.

parameters.name: MessageId
parameters.description: Specifies a message ID in Configuration Manager.

parameters.name: MessageType
parameters.description: Specifies a status message type in Configuration Manager. Valid values are: - Audit - Detail - Milestone - None

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Specifies an array of names for status filter rules.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: Specifies a change in priority. Configuration Manager checks status messages against rules in order of rule priority. Valid values are: Decrease and Increase.

parameters.name: ProcessLowerPriorityRule
parameters.description: Indicates whether to process a lower priority rule, which prevents further rule processing.

parameters.name: ProgramPath
parameters.description: Specifies a path to a program that runs when a status message matches the status filter rule.

parameters.name: PropertyId
parameters.description: Specifies a property ID in Configuration Manager.

parameters.name: PropertyValue
parameters.description: Specifies a value for the corresponding *PropertyId* parameter.

parameters.name: ReplicateToParentSite
parameters.description: Indicates whether to pass a message to the parent site.

parameters.name: ReplicationPriority
parameters.description: Specifies a replication priority for sending status messages to the parent site. Valid values are: - High - Low - Medium

parameters.name: ReportToEventLog
parameters.description: Indicates whether to report an event in the Windows event log.

parameters.name: RunProgram
parameters.description: Indicates whether to run a program when a status message matches a filter rule.

parameters.name: SeverityType
parameters.description: Specifies the severity of a status message. Valid values are: - Error - Informational - None - Warning

parameters.name: SiteCode
parameters.description: Specifies the site code for a Configuration Manager site.

parameters.name: SiteSystemServerName
parameters.description: Specifies the name of a site system server in Configuration Manager.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: Specifies the status message source to match. The possible sources are the following: - Client - SMS Provider - Site Server

parameters.name: StatusFilterRuleSiteCode
parameters.description: Specifies a site code for the site from which the status message originated.

parameters.name: WriteToDatabase
parameters.description: Indicates whether to write a message to the database. Specify a value of $True for this parameter to enable the *AllowUserDeleteMessagesAfterThresholdDays* parameter.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: Prompts you for confirmation before running the cmdlet.

parameters.name: WhatIf
parameters.description: Shows what would happen if the cmdlet runs. The cmdlet doesn't run.

parameters.name: ApplicationDeploymentSummarizer
parameters.description: Indicates that the summarizer is an application deployment status summarizer.

parameters.name: ApplicationStatisticSummarizer
parameters.description: Indicates that the summarizer is an application statistic status summarizer.

parameters.name: ComponentStatusSummarizer
parameters.description: Indicates that the summarizer is a component status summarizer.

parameters.name: CriticalSizeKB
parameters.description: Specifies the threshold, in kilobytes, of free space for a Critical message. This parameter applies to site system status summarizers.

parameters.name: DisableWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: EnableStatusSummarizer
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable Configuration Manager to summarize status messages for the site. This parameter applies to component status summarizers and site system status summarizers.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: PassThru
parameters.description: Add this parameter to return an object that represents the item with which you're working. By default, this cmdlet may not generate any output.

parameters.name: ReplicateToParentSite
parameters.description: Indicates whether to pass summarization data from this site to its parent site. This parameter applies to component status summarizers and site system status summarizers. If you specify a value of $True for this parameter, specify a priority by using the *ReplicationPriority* parameter and a threshold period by using the *ThresholdPeriod* parameter.

parameters.name: ReplicationPriority
parameters.description: Specifies the priority of replication to the parent site. The acceptable values for this parameter are: Low, Normal, and High. Specify this parameter if you specify $True for the *ReplicateToParentSite* parameter.

parameters.name: Schedule
parameters.description: Specifies a schedule object that determines how often to summarize site system status. To obtain a schedule object, use the New-CMSchedule cmdlet.

parameters.name: SiteCode
parameters.description: Specifies the site code for a Configuration Manager site.

parameters.name: SiteSystemStatusSummarizer
parameters.description: Indicates that the summarizer is a site system status summarizer.

parameters.name: WarningSizeKB
parameters.description: Specifies the threshold, in kilobytes, of free space for a Warning message. This parameter applies to site system status summarizers.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: Prompts you for confirmation before running the cmdlet.

parameters.name: WhatIf
parameters.description: Shows what would happen if the cmdlet runs. The cmdlet doesn't run.

parameters.name: AddCondition
parameters.description: Specify a condition object to add to this step. To get this object, use one of the task sequence condition cmdlets. For example, Get-CMTSStepConditionVariable.

parameters.name: ClearCondition
parameters.description: Remove a condition from this step. Use the -Condition parameter to specify the condition to remove.

parameters.name: Condition
parameters.description: Specify a condition object to use with this step. To get this object, use one of the task sequence condition cmdlets. For example, Get-CMTSStepConditionVariable.

parameters.name: ConditionVariableName
parameters.description: Specify the name of the task sequence variable to use as a condition.

parameters.name: ConditionVariableValue
parameters.description: Specify the value of the task sequence variable to use in a condition.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Specify an optional description for this task sequence step.

parameters.name: Destination
parameters.description: Specify the location where you want to apply this data image. If you don't specify this parameter, the default is NextAvailableFormattedPartition. - NextAvailableFormattedPartition: Use the next sequential partition not already targeted by an Apply Operating System or Apply Data Image step in this task sequence. - SpecificDiskAndPartition: Specify the disk number with the DestinationDisk parameter and the partition number with the DestinationPartition parameter. - SpecificLogicalDriverLetter: Use the DestinationDriveLetter parameter to specify the logical drive letter assigned to the partition by Windows PE. This drive letter can be different from the drive letter assigned by the newly deployed OS. - LogicalDriverLetterInVariable: Use the DestinationVariable parameter to specify the task sequence variable containing the drive letter assigned to the partition by Windows PE. This variable is typically set with the DiskNumberVariable parameter of the Set-CMTSStepPartitionDisk or New-CMTSStepPartitionDisk cmdlets for the Format and Partition Disk task sequence step.

parameters.name: DestinationDisk
parameters.description: When you use -Destination SpecificDiskAndPartition, use this parameter to specify the disk number. Specify an integer from 0 to 99. Also use the DestinationPartition parameter.

parameters.name: DestinationDriveLetter
parameters.description: When you use -Destination SpecificLogicalDriverLetter, use this parameter to specify the logical drive letter. Specify a drive letter from C to Z.

parameters.name: DestinationPartition
parameters.description: When you use -Destination SpecificDiskAndPartition, use this parameter to specify the partition number. Specify an integer from 1 to 99. Also use the DestinationDisk parameter.

parameters.name: DestinationVariable
parameters.description: When you use -Destination LogicalDriverLetterInVariable, use this parameter to specify the task sequence variable with the logical drive letter. The variable name needs to alphanumeric without spaces and fewer than 256 characters.

parameters.name: DisableWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: FileDateTimeOperator
parameters.description: Specify a variable operator type for a file date/time condition.

parameters.name: FilePath
parameters.description: Specify the path for a file condition.

parameters.name: FileTimestamp
parameters.description: Specify a date/time value to use for a file condition.

parameters.name: FileVersion
parameters.description: Specify a version string for a file condition.

parameters.name: FolderDateTimeOperator
parameters.description: Specify a variable operator for a folder date/time condition.

parameters.name: FolderPath
parameters.description: Specify the path for a folder condition.

parameters.name: FolderTimestamp
parameters.description: Specify a date/time value to use for a folder condition.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: ImagePackage
parameters.description: Specify a data image package object. The step applies the data from this image. Use the ImagePackageIndex parameter to set the image index. To get this object, use the Get-CMOperatingSystemImage cmdlet.

parameters.name: ImagePackageIndex
parameters.description: Specify an integer value of the image index. Use this parameter with the ImagePackage parameter.

parameters.name: InputObject
parameters.description: Specify a task sequence object that has the Apply Data Image step to configure. To get this object, use the Get-CMTaskSequence cmdlet.

parameters.name: IsAnyVersion
parameters.description: Use this parameter with the SetConditionSoftware parameter to match any version of the product.

parameters.name: IsContinueOnError
parameters.description: Use this parameter to enable the step option Continue on error. When you enable this option, if the step fails, the task sequence continues.

parameters.name: IsEnabled
parameters.description: Use this parameter to enable this task sequence step.

parameters.name: MoveToIndex
parameters.description: Move this step to the specified index position in the task sequence.

parameters.name: MsiFilePath
parameters.description: Specify the path to a Windows Installer file for a software condition.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: Specify the namespace for a WMI query condition.

parameters.name: NewStepName

parameters.name: OperatorType
parameters.description: Specify an operator to use with a task sequence variable condition.

parameters.name: Query
parameters.description: Specify a WMI query string to use for a condition.

parameters.name: RegistryKey

parameters.name: RegistryOperator
parameters.description: Specify an operator to use with a registry condition.

parameters.name: RegistryValueData
parameters.description: Specify the value data to use with a registry condition.

parameters.name: RegistryValueName
parameters.description: Specify the value name to use with a registry condition.

parameters.name: SetConditionVariable
parameters.description: Add a new task sequence variable condition.

parameters.name: StatementType
parameters.description: Set the type for an if statement condition.

parameters.name: StepName
parameters.description: Specify the name of the step to select for changes.

parameters.name: StepOrder
parameters.description: Use this parameter to reorder the step in the task sequence.

parameters.name: SupportedPlatform
parameters.description: Use this parameter to specify the platforms for an OS condition.

parameters.name: TaskSequenceId
parameters.description: Specify the package ID of the task sequence with the Apply Data Image step to configure. This value is a standard package ID, for example XYZ00858.

parameters.name: TaskSequenceName
parameters.description: Specify the name of the task sequence to target for changes.

parameters.name: ValueType
parameters.description: Specify the type of value for a registry condition.

parameters.name: VersionOperator
parameters.description: Specify an operator to use with a file condition.

parameters.name: WipePartition
parameters.description: Set this parameter to $true to delete all content on the partition before applying the image. Set this parameter to $false to not delete the prior contents of the partition. This action can be used to apply more content to a previously targeted partition.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: Prompts you for confirmation before running the cmdlet.

parameters.name: WhatIf
parameters.description: Shows what would happen if the cmdlet runs. The cmdlet doesn't run.

parameters.name: AddCondition
parameters.description: Specify a condition object to add to this step. To get this object, use one of the task sequence condition cmdlets. For example, Get-CMTSStepConditionVariable.

parameters.name: ClearCondition
parameters.description: Remove a condition from this step. Use the -Condition parameter to specify the condition to remove.

parameters.name: Condition
parameters.description: Specify a condition object to use with this step. To get this object, use one of the task sequence condition cmdlets. For example, Get-CMTSStepConditionVariable.

parameters.name: ConditionVariableName
parameters.description: Specify the name of the task sequence variable to use as a condition.

parameters.name: ConditionVariableValue
parameters.description: Specify the value of the task sequence variable to use in a condition.

parameters.name: CreateKeyOption
parameters.description: Use one of the following values to specify where to create the recovery key: - ActiveDirectoryDomainServices: Create the recovery password and escrow it in Active Directory (recommended) - DoNotCreateRecoveryKey: Encrypt the drive, but don't create a recovery password.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Specify an optional description for this task sequence step.

parameters.name: DisableWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: Drive
parameters.description: Specify the drive to encrypt.

parameters.name: EnableSkipWhenNoValidTpm
parameters.description: Applies to version 2006 and later. Set this parameter to true to skip this step for computers that don't have a TPM or when the TPM isn't enabled.

parameters.name: EncryptionMethod
parameters.description: Applies to version 2006 and later. Use this parameter to specify the disk encryption mode. By default or if not specified, the step continues to use the default encryption method for the OS version.

parameters.name: FileDateTimeOperator
parameters.description: Specify a variable operator type for a file date/time condition.

parameters.name: FilePath
parameters.description: Specify the path for a file condition.

parameters.name: FileTimestamp
parameters.description: Specify a date/time value to use for a file condition.

parameters.name: FileVersion
parameters.description: Specify a version string for a file condition.

parameters.name: FolderDateTimeOperator
parameters.description: Specify a variable operator for a folder date/time condition.

parameters.name: FolderPath
parameters.description: Specify the path for a folder condition.

parameters.name: FolderTimestamp
parameters.description: Specify a date/time value to use for a folder condition.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: InputObject
parameters.description: Specify a task sequence object from which to get the Enable BitLocker step. To get this object, use the Get-CMTaskSequence cmdlet.

parameters.name: IsAnyVersion
parameters.description: Use this parameter with the SetConditionSoftware parameter to match any version of the product.

parameters.name: IsContinueOnError
parameters.description: Use this parameter to enable the step option Continue on error. When you enable this option, if the step fails, the task sequence continues.

parameters.name: IsEnabled
parameters.description: Use this parameter to enable this task sequence step.

parameters.name: IsEncryptFullDisk
parameters.description: Set this parameter to $true to use full disk encryption. By default, the Enable BitLocker step only encrypts used space on the drive.

parameters.name: IsWaitingForBitLockerComplete
parameters.description: Set this parameter to $true to configure the step to wait for BitLocker to complete the drive encryption process on all drives before continuing task sequence execution.

parameters.name: MoveToIndex
parameters.description: Move this step to the specified index position in the task sequence.

parameters.name: MsiFilePath

parameters.name: TpmAndPin
parameters.description: Add this parameter to configure key management for the OS drive to use a TPM and a personal identification number (PIN). When you specify this option, BitLocker locks the normal boot process until the user provides the PIN. If you use this parameter, use Pin to specify the PIN value. You can't combine this parameter with TpmAndUsb, TpmOnly, or UsbOnly.

parameters.name: TpmAndUsb
parameters.description: Add this parameter to configure key management for the OS drive to use a TPM and a startup key stored on a USB flash drive. When you select this option, BitLocker locks the normal boot process until a USB device that contains a BitLocker startup key is attached to the computer. You can't combine this parameter with TpmAndPin, TpmOnly, or UsbOnly.

parameters.name: TpmOnly
parameters.description: Add this parameter to configure key management for the OS drive to only use a TPM. You can't combine this parameter with TpmAndPin, TpmAndUsb, or UsbOnly.

parameters.name: UsbOnly
parameters.description: Add this parameter to configure key management for the OS drive to only use a startup key stored on a USB flash drive. When you select this option, BitLocker locks the normal boot process until a USB device that contains a BitLocker startup key is attached to the computer. You can't combine this parameter with TpmAndPin, TpmAndUsb, or TpmOnly.

parameters.name: AddCondition
parameters.description: Specify a condition object to add to this step. To get this object, use one of the task sequence condition cmdlets. For example, Get-CMTSStepConditionVariable.

parameters.name: CheckCMClientMinVersion
parameters.description: Set this parameter to $true to enable the Minimum client version check. Use the parameter CMClientMinVersion to set the specific client version number.

parameters.name: CheckMaxOSVersion
parameters.description: Set this parameter to $true to enable the Maximum OS version check. Use the parameter MaxOSVersion to set the specific OS version number.

parameters.name: CheckMemory
parameters.description: Set this parameter to $true to enable the Minimum memory (MB) check. Use the parameter Memory to set the specific memory size.

parameters.name: CheckMinOSVersion
parameters.description: Set this parameter to $true to enable the Minimum OS version check. Use the parameter MinOSVersion to set the specific OS version number.

parameters.name: CheckNetworkConnected
parameters.description: Set this parameter to $true to enable the Network adapter connected check.

parameters.name: CheckNetworkWired
parameters.description: Set this parameter to $true to enable the Network adapter is not wireless check.

parameters.name: CheckOS
parameters.description: Set this parameter to $true to enable the check for the type of OS, either client or server. Use the parameter OS to set the specific OS type.

parameters.name: CheckOSArchitecture
parameters.description: Set this parameter to $true to enable the Architecture of current OS check. Use the parameter OSArchitecture to set the specific architecture type.

parameters.name: CheckOSLanguageId
parameters.description: Set this parameter to $true to enable the check of the Language of current OS. Use the parameter OSLanguageID to set the specific language.

parameters.name: CheckPowerState
parameters.description: Set this parameter to $true to enable the AC power plugged in check.

parameters.name: CheckSpace
parameters.description: Set this parameter to $true to enable the Minimum free disk space (MB) check. Use the parameter DiskSpace to set the specific size.

parameters.name: CheckSpeed
parameters.description: Set this parameter to $true to enable the Minimum processor speed (MHz) check. Use the parameter Speed to set the specific speed.

parameters.name: CheckTpmActivated
parameters.description: Applies to version 2111 and later. Set this parameter to $true to enable the TPM 2.0 or above is activated check.

parameters.name: CheckTpmEnabled
parameters.description: Applies to version 2111 and later. Set this parameter to $true to enable the TPM 2.0 or above is enabled check.

parameters.name: CheckUefi
parameters.description: Applies to version 2006 and later. Set this parameter to $true to enable the Computer is in UEFI mode check.

parameters.name: ClearCondition
parameters.description: Remove a condition from this step. Use the -Condition parameter to specify the condition to remove.

parameters.name: CMClientMinVersion
parameters.description: Use this parameter to configure the specific client version. Specify the client version in the following format: 5.00.8913.1005. Use the parameter CheckCMClientMinVersion to enable or disable the check.

parameters.name: Condition
parameters.description: Specify a condition object to use with this step. To get this object, use one of the task sequence condition cmdlets. For example, Get-CMTSStepConditionVariable.

parameters.name: ConditionVariableName
parameters.description: Specify the name of the task sequence variable to use as a condition.

parameters.name: ConditionVariableValue
parameters.description: Specify the value of the task sequence variable to use in a condition.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Specify an optional description for this task sequence step.

parameters.name: DisableWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: DiskSpace
parameters.description: Use this parameter to configure the specific size for the minimum free disk space check. Specify an integer value for the size in MB. Use the parameter CheckSpace to enable or disable the check.

parameters.name: FileDateTimeOperator
parameters.description: Specify a variable operator type for a file date/time condition.

parameters.name: FilePath
parameters.description: Specify the path for a file condition.

parameters.name: FileTimestamp
parameters.description: Specify a date/time value to use for a file condition.

parameters.name: FileVersion
parameters.description: Specify a version string for a file condition.

parameters.name: FolderDateTimeOperator
parameters.description: Specify a variable operator for a folder date/time condition.

parameters.name: FolderPath
parameters.description: Specify the path for a folder condition.

parameters.name: FolderTimestamp
parameters.description: Specify a date/time value to use for a folder condition.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: InputObject
parameters.description: Specify a task sequence object from which to get the Check Readiness step. To get this object, use the Get-CMTaskSequence cmdlet.

parameters.name: IsAnyVersion
parameters.description: Use this parameter with the SetConditionSoftware parameter to match any version of the product.

parameters.name: IsContinueOnError
parameters.description: Use this parameter to enable the step option Continue on error. When you enable this option, if the step fails, the task sequence continues.

parameters.name: IsEnabled
parameters.description: Use this parameter to enable this task sequence step.

parameters.name: MaxOSVersion
parameters.description: Use this parameter to configure the specific OS version. Specify the maximum OS version with major version, minor version, and build number. For example, 10.0.18356. Use the parameter CheckMaxOSVersion to enable or disable the check.

parameters.name: Memory
parameters.description: Use this parameter to configure the specific size for the minimum memory check. Specify an integer value for the size in MB. Use the parameter CheckMemory to enable or disable the check.

parameters.name: MinOSVersion
parameters.description: Use this parameter to configure the specific OS version. Specify the minimum OS version with major version, minor version, and build number. For example, 10.0.16299. Use the parameter CheckMinOSVersion to enable or disable the check.

parameters.name: MoveToIndex
parameters.description: Move this step to the specified index position in the task sequence.

parameters.name: MsiFilePath
parameters.description: Specify the path to a Windows Installer file for a software condition.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: Specify the namespace for a WMI query condition.

parameters.name: NewStepName
parameters.description: Use this parameter to rename this task sequence step.

parameters.name: OperatorType

This option is less secure because other computers could use the network access account to access the stored state. This option might be necessary if the destination computer isn't domain joined. For more information, see Network access account.

parameters.name: RequestOption
parameters.description: Specify the reason to request access to the state migration point: - Capture: Capture state from the computer. If the Configuration Manager site has multiple active state migration points, this step finds a state migration point with available disk space. The task sequence queries the management point for a list of state migration points, and then evaluates each until it finds one that meets the minimum requirements. - Restore: Restore state from another computer. If there are multiple state migration points, this step finds the state migration point that has the state for the destination computer.

parameters.description: Specify the number of times that this step tries to find an appropriate state migration point before failing.
